findings.scenario: A reply links to /thread/root/parent when that parent is beyond the first30 thread rows. render fetches only the first page and focusRoute runs once; target is absent and deep link silently lands elsewhere. Load more does not rerun target focus.
findings.repair: Resolve the targeted canonical post with bounded public reads, verify its root, render/focus the correct target without weakening thread authority. Add a beyond-first-page deep-link regression.

findings.scenario: Read beyond the first30 feed/thread rows, open a profile, then return. Only scroll/focus is retained, so render reloads30 rows and tries restoring the old larger offset against a shorter page. The earlier reading location is lost.
findings.repair: Preserve bounded pagination restoration state or a canonical visible-post anchor and fetch enough authorized content to restore that anchor. Test forward/back navigation after pagination.
